html:
SMTO-MEM-0034 — Knowledge is missing a program it needs

GUID: ca4214c1-0a9f-51c0-b64c-783cfd56b0b8
Slug: knowledge-rag-dependencies-unavailable
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • Knowledge uses a separate helper program to read documents and match memories. That program, or a part it needs, is missing on the server, so documents can't be processed or searched by meaning right now.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open System Health and select Check Knowledge. This shows whether the Knowledge installation is complete and gives your administrator the details they need.
  2. Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Ask them to run the Knowledge installation repair on the server. The missing part has to be installed on the server computer; it can't be done from the app.
  3. After they finish, go back to System Health and select Check Knowledge again. This confirms the repair worked before you rely on Knowledge again.
  4. In Knowledge, if any documents show Indexing failed, select Retry failed jobs. Documents that failed while the program was missing are processed again.

What success looks like

  • Check Knowledge passes and your documents reach Ready to search.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete your documents or collections; they are kept and will be processed once the installation is repaired.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Knowledge processing worker could not run because its Python environment under the Knowledge installation directory (venv or venv-cuda) is missing its python executable (WorkerClient.start), or the worker failed to import a required package.

What this means

  • One or more installed programs or model files needed for Knowledge cannot be used. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported rag_dependencies_unavailable. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • Knowledge’s installation verification passes.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Check that installation/rag/venv/bin/python (or venv-cuda, or Scripts\python.exe on Windows) exists and that the worker environment can import its pinned packages. Stop the server with its normal launcher, run python -m agent_runtime.rag.install in the application's Python environment with the same state-directory configuration (use --root only for the existing installation/rag directory), start the server, then run Check Knowledge on System Health. The installer may download dependencies and models; the UI never runs it.
  • Ask the server administrator to repair the Knowledge dependency profile using the installation instructions, then run Check current status.
  • Administrator: stop the controller using its normal launcher. With the application's Python environment and the same state-directory configuration, run python -m agent_runtime.rag.install, then start the controller again and run Check Knowledge. Use --root PATH only for the existing installation/rag directory. This installer may download dependencies and models; the UI does not run it automatically.

Retry and execution caution

  • Knowledge’s installation verification passes.

How to verify the fix

  • Knowledge’s installation verification passes.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
